release_notes:
- Official JURA USB Service Interface hardware 4:1 bridge auto-detection (raw '&'-frame vs. 4:1 wire framing) to prevent double 4:1 encoding on Smart Connect machines
- Fixed Smart Connect Mode B @TR:32 bank stride (4 words/bank) and Memory Mapper block-by-block Smart Connect fallback with ~4s fast-fail abort_sweep
- Hardened web_server security (static path traversal 403, Origin CSRF check, strict JSON validation, ~/Downloads HMI containment, _session_lock cache sync & non-blocking diagnostics)
- Hardened self-updater (mandatory SHA-256 verification, HTTPS GitHub host allowlist, safe tarball extraction) and atomic 0600 GitHub OAuth token persistence
- Fixed Local AI duplicate definitions, OCR NameError, warm model retention across upload calibration, and strict eeprom_words proof verification for community calibrations
- Added frontend AbortController sweep cancellation, cross-port race guards, and 3-retry Device Flow network tolerance
